decision.rationale: I recommend a provisional credit of 64.84 EUR. Transaction TXN-008014 is on card CRD-000037. It is a 64.84 EUR charge from Meadowlark Fitness (MER-000045), a merchant that bills on a recurring basis. The charge was made on 2026-08-31 and posted on 2026-09-01. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 59 days after posting, so it is inside the 120-day limit (time-limits). Document DOC-000046 is a cancellation confirmation issued by the merchant. It says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-08-23. That date is before the 2026-08-31 charge, so the charge should not have been made (recurring-cancelled-before-charge). The credit is the disputed charge only, 6484 minor units. This matches the amount claimed and is under the 3,000.00 EUR limit for provisional credit (provisional-credit). The document contains no instructions.
